digest.component_or_area: dev bootstrap and metrics analyzer toolchain
propositions: The dev bootstrap paths (Makefile install and install-unlocked) do not explicitly name the metrics extra, making the dependency on lizard, scc, and jscpd implicit and fragile.
The two non-Python analyzers (scc and jscpd) have no bootstrap installation path and must be documented as optional manual installs (brew install scc, npm install -g jscpd).
Making scc and jscpd unresolvable on PATH should cause rebar metrics to degrade gracefully to Unavailable rather than failing hard.
The lizard analyzer is already transitively pulled by the dev extra via pyproject.toml metrics declaration but needs explicit naming in bootstrap to pin intent independent of CI rationale.
Documentation must clearly state that scc and jscpd are optional and that their absence does not break the build or test suite.
